decision: Sam's explicit decision of 2026-11-05 in Claude Code session f804490c: "全部批准，我作為project owner 批準你幫我發digest，CI綠了就merge", answering the consolidated proposal for TASK-019 (1 new client test file, 23 case definitions running 31 times, and support pins for PurchaseOrdersPage.vue, PurchaseOrderDetailPage.vue and PurchaseOrderProgress.vue), and a one-time project-owner authorization for the agent to publish this receipt's digest
purpose: The PO list and detail pages show write actions only with purchasing.mgmt and server-allowed actions, restore filters, page and sort from the URL, keep the transaction snapshot apart from current master data, show exact Base quantities beyond 2^53, ignore late responses, refuse invalid route IDs before calling the API, and retry Copy with the same eventId while the outcome is unknown
data: No database or network: mocked services and small inline objects. No fixture files
thresholds: All cases pass; coverage floors unchanged
trigger: Routine correctness regression on every PR and push to main, in the existing client test job
cost: Measured locally: about 0.3 s for the file. CI not measured, estimated under 1 s added. No new job and no capacity
